stem: Which record is most interpretable later?

stimulus.title: Measurement event context
stimulus.description: A technician is documenting a completed input-solution conductivity check. Select the record entry that would let a later reviewer reconstruct the observation without relying on the technician's memory.
stimulus.note: The task is to preserve the measurement together with the context needed to understand who measured what, where/for which material, when, and with which instrument.

choices: EC 2.1 mS/cm, Batch B17 input solution, 14:05, Meter M4, operator initials
rationale: A useful measurement includes type, unit, material/sample identity, time and other context needed for reconstruction.
